items.title: FAA orders nationwide ground stop for all flights, airline stocks fall
items.summary: Airline stocks fell right before Friday's close after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ordered a nationwide ground stop. Departing flights cannot take off, while flights already in the air may continue to their destination.

items.title: High fuel costs, Starlink, and the beauty of AI alerts: United Airlines CEO
items.summary: United Airlines (UAL) CEO Scott Kirby joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss the impact of rising fuel costs, changes he expects to see in the airline industry over the next few years, and more.

items.title: United is the first airline to ban bookings from Meta’s AI agent, Muse: 'I don't want to create another middleman'

items.title: United’s CEO Says He’s “100%” Sure an American Deal Could Be Approved
items.summary: Scott Kirby keeps pitching a rival that already slammed the door, and regulators are not the hurdle he fears most. With fuel costs squeezing every carrier, what is he really signaling, and who is the message meant for?

items.title: United Airlines Blocks AI Agents From Booking Flights as Analyst Says Carrier Wants to Avoid Another Google-Like Intermediary
